observations.text: Park officials described movements consistent with sportfishing near Clarión Island.
The authority’s two monitoring figures show the vessel’s transmission ending near the island.

title: Park entry followed by signal loss

observations.text: The park authority received a satellite-platform alert when the vessel entered the park.
Figures 5 and 6 place the vessel near Clarión Island when its signal stopped. The authority referred its observations for investigation.
BLOOM estimated 468 hours of apparent trawling by one vessel during 2023. The authors could not determine which gear was deployed.
Kiribati’s monitoring report identified five vessels within the protected area and assessed them as cruising without fishing.
